start.name: Village_of_Ashfield
start.description: A quiet rural settlement at the edge of the kingdom. Beneath its old well lies a sealed passage that predates the kingdom itself.

art.gallery.name: The Starry Atelier
art.gallery.description: A surreal workshop where painters reshape reality. Paintings change whenever nobody watches them.

cinema.house.name: The Eternal Projection
cinema.house.description: An abandoned cinema where forgotten films predict events that have not yet occurred.

fiction.loft.name: The Epicenter
fiction.loft.description: A tower of impossible stories inhabited by heroes, monsters, and characters who know they are fictional.

dragon.spire.name: The Dragon's Observatory
dragon.spire.description: A tower above the clouds where ancient dragons study the movements of stars and the fate of mortals.

FIDE.hall.name: The Grandmaster's Chamber
FIDE.hall.description: A monumental chess hall where the greatest strategists compete for the right to advise kings.

philosophers.retreat.name: The Abyss
philosophers.retreat.description: A desolate sanctuary where philosophers debate freedom, morality, suffering, and whether reality exists at all.

west.end.name: The Crossroads
west.end.description: A sprawling trading junction where smugglers, wandering poets, mercenaries, and merchants exchange rumors.

chapel.hill.name: The Pinnacle
chapel.hill.description: A fortified hilltop overlooking the kingdom. Political rivals gather here to negotiate, threaten, and conspire.

sunken.archive.name: The Drowned Archive
sunken.archive.description: A flooded underground library holding the censored histories of fallen civilizations. Some books whisper to readers.

thinkers.library.name: The Reading Room
thinkers.library.description: An enormous library connecting natural science, mathematics, philosophy, and forbidden research.

emerald.forest.name: The Emerald Wilds
emerald.forest.description: An ancient forest where trees remember every traveler and strange creatures guard the roots of the world.

kingsroad.name: The King's Road
kingsroad.description: A heavily traveled highway crossing the continent. Abandoned watchtowers hint at a war erased from history.

capital.city.name: Veyrath, Capital of Crowns
capital.city.description: A vast metropolis of royal courts, crowded markets, guild halls, and secret societies. Every district answers to a different power.

royal.citadel.name: The Iron Crown
royal.citadel.description: The royal stronghold, protected by elite soldiers and enchanted gates. A succession crisis threatens to plunge the kingdom into civil war.

frostbound.pass.name: The Frostbound Pass
frostbound.pass.description: A mountain crossing where blizzards conceal ancient statues and the frozen remains of an expedition.

dwarven.hold.name: Khar-Dur, the Deep Forge
dwarven.hold.description: A subterranean city of master smiths, enormous furnaces, and mechanical wonders powered by the earth's heart.

crystal.caves.name: The Resonant Depths
crystal.caves.description: A labyrinth of luminous crystals that amplify memories and emotions. The deeper chambers distort time.

ashlands.name: The Kingdom of Cinders
ashlands.description: A scorched wasteland where a magical catastrophe destroyed an entire civilization. Ghostly lights drift between ruined towers.

obsidian.gate.name: The World's End
obsidian.gate.description: A colossal black gate at the edge of the known world. Beyond it lies a realm absent from every map and forbidden in every scripture.

rook.name: Chess Rook
rook.description: A carved stone chess piece. Its markings resemble the layout of an ancient fortress.

heaven.name: Gilded Canvas
heaven.description: A masterpiece that radiates impossible light. Its painted landscape changes with the viewer's memories.

philosophical_stone.name: Philosopher's Fragment
philosophical_stone.description: A shard of an artifact said to contain the essence of thought itself.

diamond.name: Uncut Diamond
diamond.description: A valuable rough diamond coveted by merchants, nobles, and thieves.

gold.name: Gold Ingot
gold.description: A heavy bar of pure gold bearing the seal of a forgotten dynasty.

oscar.name: Golden Laurel
oscar.description: A legendary award recognizing an achievement that changed the course of artistic history.

healing_herb.name: Ashfield Healing Herb
healing_herb.description: A common medicinal plant that restores a small amount of health.

silver_reel.name: Silver Film Reel
silver_reel.description: A reel containing a scene that reveals a hidden passage when projected.

infinite_book.name: The Infinite Book
infinite_book.description: A book whose final chapter cannot be reached. It contains hints about hidden locations.

dragon_scale.name: Elder Dragon Scale
dragon_scale.description: A nearly indestructible scale warm to the touch. Its owner can sense nearby magic.

ancient_coin.name: Coin of the First King
ancient_coin.description: A coin minted before the founding of the kingdom. Collectors pay fortunes for it.

lost_chronicle.name: The Lost Chronicle
lost_chronicle.description: A forbidden manuscript detailing the true origin of the Obsidian Gate.

mechanical_key.name: Clockwork Key
mechanical_key.description: An intricate key designed to open ancient mechanisms and sealed vaults.

moonflower.name: Moonflower
moonflower.description: A luminous flower that blooms only under moonlight. It can be used to craft powerful medicine.

enchanted_bark.name: Enchanted Bark
enchanted_bark.description: A piece of living wood that slowly regenerates when exposed to sunlight.

soldiers_medallion.name: Veteran's Medallion
soldiers_medallion.description: A military insignia recognized by the royal guard.

royal_seal.name: Royal Seal
royal_seal.description: An official seal that grants access to restricted government buildings.

healing_potion.name: Greater Healing Potion
healing_potion.description: A carefully brewed potion that restores a substantial amount of health.

crown_of_ashes.name: Crown of Ashes
crown_of_ashes.description: A cursed crown belonging to the ruler who destroyed the ancient civilization.

frost_crystal.name: Frost Crystal
frost_crystal.description: A fragment of permanent ice that remains frozen even beside a roaring furnace.

mithril_ingot.name: Mithril Ingot
mithril_ingot.description: A rare lightweight metal used to forge weapons and armor of exceptional quality.

forge_hammer.name: Master Smith's Hammer
forge_hammer.description: A legendary crafting hammer capable of repairing ancient artifacts.

heart_crystal.name: Crystal Heart
heart_crystal.description: A pulsating crystal that amplifies magical abilities.

void_shard.name: Void Shard
void_shard.description: A fragment of nothingness that seems to absorb light and sound.

ember_crown.name: Ember Crown
ember_crown.description: A relic containing the last living flame of the fallen kingdom.

obsidian_blade.name: Obsidian Blade
obsidian_blade.description: A razor-sharp weapon forged from volcanic glass and dark magic.

worldheart.name: Heart of the World
worldheart.description: An ancient artifact said to sustain reality. Its power could restore or unmake the world.

magnus_carlsen.name: Grandmaster Magnus
magnus_carlsen.description: A calm, calculating chess champion who treats every conversation as a strategic contest.

rene_descartes.name: René the Skeptic
rene_descartes.description: A philosopher who questions everything, including the reliability of his own senses.

charles_darwin.name: Charles the Naturalist
charles_darwin.description: A patient naturalist studying the unusual creatures of the Emerald Wilds.

pablo_picasso.name: Pablo the Visionary
pablo_picasso.description: An artist who believes reality is merely a canvas waiting to be rearranged.

franz_kafka.name: Franz the Scribe
franz_kafka.description: A troubled writer haunted by an incomprehensible bureaucracy.

fiodor_dostoievsky.name: Fyodor the Confessor
fiodor_dostoievsky.description: A feverish thinker who searches for redemption in the darkest corners of the human soul.

snoop_dogg.name: Calvin the Storyteller
snoop_dogg.description: A charismatic wanderer whose rhymes conceal rumors about the kingdom's secret rulers.

martin_scorsesse.name: Martin the Auteur
martin_scorsesse.description: A demanding director determined to produce a trilogy that will outlive every kingdom.

saitama.name: Saitama the Bored
saitama.description: A hero of overwhelming strength who searches for a challenge worthy of his attention.

donald_trump.name: The Gilded Orator
donald_trump.description: A powerful political figure whose promises and ambitions dominate the hilltop.

frida_kahlo.name: Frida the Dreamer
frida_kahlo.description: A painter who transforms pain and memory into images that can heal or destroy.

alfred_hitchcock.name: The Master of Suspense
alfred_hitchcock.description: A filmmaker who notices every suspicious movement and every detail others overlook.

bobby_fischer.name: The Isolated Champion
bobby_fischer.description: A brilliant and unpredictable chess player who guards the secrets of an ancient opening.

sherlock_holmes.name: The Consulting Detective
sherlock_holmes.description: A sharp-eyed investigator who can reconstruct entire events from a single footprint.

elder_dragon.name: Azhur, the Elder Dragon
elder_dragon.description: An ancient dragon who remembers the world before humanity learned to write.

old_miller.name: Old Miller Rowan
old_miller.description: A humble villager who knows more about the sealed well than he admits.

traveling_merchant.name: Merrick the Merchant
traveling_merchant.description: A traveling trader who deals in unusual artifacts and unreliable information.

royal_spy.name: The Whisper
royal_spy.description: A masked intelligence agent who knows the private affairs of every noble in the capital.

archivist_mira.name: Mira of the Drowned Archive
archivist_mira.description: A scholar who has learned to read the memories trapped inside submerged manuscripts.

ada_lovelace.name: Ada the Enchantress of Numbers
ada_lovelace.description: A mathematician who designs mechanical minds capable of predicting possible futures.

forest_guardian.name: The Verdant Guardian
forest_guardian.description: A towering spirit that protects the forest against those who take without giving.

wandering_druid.name: Elder Willow
wandering_druid.description: A wandering healer who understands the language of plants and forgotten spirits.

captain_arden.name: Captain of the King's Road
captain_arden.description: A veteran commander investigating attacks against royal supply caravans.

queen_isolde.name: Queen Isolde
queen_isolde.description: A calculating monarch attempting to preserve a fragile peace amid rival claims to the throne.

guildmaster_voss.name: Master Voss
guildmaster_voss.description: The leader of the merchant guild, able to turn a rumor into a fortune.

street_oracle.name: The Street Oracle
street_oracle.description: A mysterious prophet whose cryptic predictions sometimes come true in disturbing detail.

black_knight.name: The Black Knight
black_knight.description: An armored warrior bound by oath to defend the royal vault, regardless of the cost.

mountain_hermit.name: The Frozen Hermit
mountain_hermit.description: A former royal astronomer who fled into the mountains after discovering an impossible constellation.

thane_brom.name: Thane Brom Ironvein
thane_brom.description: The stubborn ruler of Khar-Dur, determined to protect the secrets of dwarven metallurgy.

master_smith.name: Helga the Master Smith
master_smith.description: A legendary craftswoman who can forge weapons from nearly any magical material.

crystal_keeper.name: The Resonant Keeper
crystal_keeper.description: A silent being formed from crystal who protects the cave's living heart.

exiled_mage.name: Malrec the Exile
exiled_mage.description: A disgraced royal mage who claims the catastrophe that created the Ashlands was an experiment gone wrong.

ash_wraith.name: The Ash Wraith
ash_wraith.description: A restless spirit born from the final moments of the destroyed civilization.

gatekeeper.name: The Keeper Beyond
gatekeeper.description: A timeless guardian who tests every traveler seeking to pass beyond the known world.

nameless_king.name: The Nameless King
nameless_king.description: A forgotten sovereign whose existence was removed from history to prevent a terrible prophecy.

trump_diamond.name: The Exchange
trump_diamond.description: Retrieve the diamond from the Crossroads and bring it to Picasso at the Starry Atelier.

doogy_saitama.name: The Clearing
doogy_saitama.description: Resolve the conflict between two notorious wanderers who have disrupted the peace of the kingdom.

gold_rook.name: The Trilogy
gold_rook.description: Gather three relics required to complete Martin's legendary cinematic trilogy.

sealed_well.name: The Secret Beneath Ashfield
sealed_well.description: Discover what lies beneath the village well and learn why its entrance was sealed.

chess_legacy.name: The Unwinnable Game
chess_legacy.description: Recover the ancient chess relics and defeat a strategic challenge designed by the greatest grandmasters.

wildlife_study.name: The Origin of Species
wildlife_study.description: Study the unusual creatures of the Emerald Wilds and return with proof of their adaptations.

living_painting.name: A World on Canvas
living_painting.description: Recover the rare materials required to restore a painting that has begun swallowing its surroundings.

missing_reel.name: The Lost Final Cut
missing_reel.description: Find a missing film reel containing evidence of a royal conspiracy.

impossible_murder.name: The Case of the Empty Room
impossible_murder.description: Investigate a murder in a locked chamber and identify the culprit using physical evidence.

dragon_bargain.name: An Ancient Bargain
dragon_bargain.description: Negotiate with Azhur for a dragon scale and learn the truth about the world's first civilization.

crown_conspiracy.name: A Kingdom Divided
crown_conspiracy.description: Uncover the conspiracy surrounding the succession crisis and decide whom the crown should trust.

road_bandits.name: Blood on the King's Road
road_bandits.description: Investigate attacks on royal caravans and restore safe passage across the kingdom.

lost_chronicle.name: The Drowned Truth
lost_chronicle.description: Recover a forbidden manuscript from the Drowned Archive and bring its revelations to Mira.

clockwork_prophecy.name: The Machine That Dreams
clockwork_prophecy.description: Help Ada complete a predictive machine that has begun producing warnings about the end of the world.

forest_balance.name: The Green Covenant
forest_balance.description: Restore balance to the Emerald Wilds by finding the source of the forest's spreading corruption.

moonflower_remedy.name: Medicine for the Forgotten
moonflower_remedy.description: Gather rare herbs to prepare a remedy for the inhabitants of the Ashlands.

guild_monopoly.name: The Price of Everything
guild_monopoly.description: Investigate the merchant guild's control of essential supplies and expose its hidden dealings.

three_prophecies.name: Three Possible Futures
three_prophecies.description: Investigate three prophecies that point toward different endings for the kingdom.

forge_of_ages.name: The Forge of Ages
forge_of_ages.description: Recover rare materials to reactivate an ancient forge capable of crafting legendary equipment.

crystal_heart.name: The Song Beneath the Earth
crystal_heart.description: Discover why the crystals are resonating with a signal from beyond the Obsidian Gate.

ashes_of_the_past.name: The Last Flame
ashes_of_the_past.description: Learn how the Ashlands were destroyed and decide whether the ancient magic should be restored.

worldheart.name: Beyond the End
worldheart.description: Open the Obsidian Gate, confront the Nameless King, and decide the fate of reality itself.

dialogues.play_queen: The queen is the most versatile piece on the board.
dialogues.play_rook: In the endgame, control of the rook's file is everything.
dialogues.survivor: Survival belongs to those who adapt when the world changes.
dialogues.samsa: I awoke one morning to find myself transformed into something unrecognizable.
dialogues.citation1: The mystery of existence is not in survival, but in meaning.
dialogues.citation2: Suffering is the price of a deep consciousness.
dialogues.citation3: Better to err on your own path than to walk another's perfectly.
dialogues.doggy: The road is long, but the stories make it shorter.
dialogues.pulpy: I've always been drawn to the edge of the law.
dialogues.president_dialogue0: I have a vision, and it's unparalleled.
dialogues.dialogues_about_religion: I believe in greatness, and I believe in grace.
dialogues.art_and_reality: If the world refuses to make sense, paint it differently.
dialogues.painted_wounds: Pain is not the opposite of beauty. Sometimes it is the source.
dialogues.suspense: The most frightening thing is not what you see. It is what you suspect.
dialogues.kings_gambit: Every opening is a promise. Every sacrifice is a question.
dialogues.deduction: Observe the smallest detail, and the largest mystery begins to unravel.
dialogues.dragons_memory: I watched mountains rise where seas once slept. Your kingdoms are brief dreams.
dialogues.village_secret: Some doors are sealed to keep danger out. Others are sealed to keep something in.
dialogues.merchant_trade: Everything has a price. The trick is discovering what the seller truly wants.
dialogues.secret_network: Information is the sharpest blade in the kingdom. Most rulers never see it coming.
dialogues.lost_history: The past does not disappear. It waits for someone brave enough to read it.
dialogues.machine_thought: If a machine can predict your choice, was it ever truly your choice?
dialogues.forest_trial: Take from the forest without gratitude, and the forest will remember.
dialogues.herbal_wisdom: A remedy is only as powerful as the patience with which it is prepared.
dialogues.road_patrol: The King's Road belongs to everyone, until someone decides it belongs to them alone.
dialogues.royal_audience: A crown is not proof of wisdom. It is a burden that makes every mistake public.
dialogues.guild_rules: Trade is the art of persuading people that both sides have won.
dialogues.three_prophecies: One future is built on fear, another on ambition, and the last on a choice no oracle can make for you.
dialogues.knights_oath: An oath is easy to swear before danger arrives.
dialogues.frozen_stars: The stars are moving into a pattern that should not exist.
dialogues.dwarven_oath: Stone remembers every hammer strike. So should the hands that wield it.
dialogues.smithing_secrets: A great weapon is not made by fire alone. It is made by knowing when to stop.
dialogues.crystal_song: Listen carefully. The earth is trying to tell you what it fears.
dialogues.forbidden_magic: We called it progress until the sky caught fire.
dialogues.last_breath: We were a kingdom once. Remember that before you call us monsters.
dialogues.gate_riddle: What can destroy a kingdom without touching a stone, and save a world without lifting a sword?
dialogues.nameless_truth: History did not forget me. Someone taught it to lie.
